about: The rules of spec/engine/materials.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

BFBC2Game.exe string table, file offsets 0x101AF78 - 0x101B1A2: destruction_factor, PickupSpec, LightMap, edgeModelSize, edgeModelPos, edgeModelDir, statModPrimDraw, statModPrimBuil, weaponSpecialization, cameraRoll, cameraPitch, compassRotation, turretRotation, lockWarning, healthWarning, reloadPercentage, weaponHeat, isReloading, lightPower, trackOffset, dirtColor, dirtFactor (each once in the file); the run is looked up by 0x5BF470 and set per drawn instance (MAT-TEX-20)

the run's other names are values only the game knows per object (a turret's angle, a weapon's heat, a track's scroll), so the run is the per-instance constants the renderer fills; the zero block values are then placeholders

rules.title: DirtColor and DirtFactor are per-instance values the engine writes

rules.title: Vehicle camouflage is shader set 1 (desert) or 2 (snow), picked per level

evidence.ref: spec/probes/grime.py, 2026-11-22: 58 soldier entries bind a camo texture, 38 of them another one in another database; per database the (US, RUS) pair its soldier entries bind most: woodland 22, snow 15, desert 14, woodland without RUS 2, RUS_03 only 1, none of the six 20 (Vietnam); DBX partitions referencing a Camo_* soldier texture: 0; soldier sets beyond 0: set 1 kitupgrade 20, empty 8, snow 3 (campaign headgear), other 3; set 2 all_white 4, empty 8; SoldierSpawnEntityData.MeshShaderSetNumber 1 on sp_003_b, sp_006, sp_007, 2 on sp_005

the level's camo choice is made when the content build compiles the level's database (a per-level texture substitution); the game only sees the result; the kit-upgrade reading is from the set's shader names and the override's values (-1, 0, 1)

rules.title: Soldier camouflage is bound per level in the level's shader database

evidence.ref: spec/probes/grime.py, 2026-11-22: 26 weapon entries bind a Dt_Camo_* tile, 17 of them another tile in another database; per database the tile its weapons bind most: Dt_Camo_Wood 28, Dt_Camo_Desert 13, Dt_Camo_Snow 12; against the US soldiers' camo of the same database: 49 agree, 4 differ (sp_004_b, sp_02, sp_04: wood with Camo_Snow_1; sp_006: wood with Camo_Digital); distinct entries over every database binding DesertCamo_01_D: weapons 68, vehicles 1; Dt_Camonet_RGB_01 objects 4, vehicles 1; Camonet_Oc_RGB objects 7; DynamicWeaponPickupEntityData / WeaponPickupEntityData.UseTeamShaderSet false on all 115
